Hair care made at home

Simple ingredients, precise instructions, hair treated with care.

Recipes for masks, oils and rinses to make in your kitchen, explained step by step: clear amounts, storage times and the precautions to know before you start. No miracle promises.

Our approach

Four rules that do not change

01Few things, chosen well

Every recipe uses ingredients from your kitchen or the supermarket. If an ingredient is not needed, it is not there.

02Small amounts, right away

Preparations made with water or fresh fruit spoil. The amounts are enough for one or two uses.

03Safety first

Every recipe explains the patch test and how long it keeps. If your skin reacts, you stop.

04No miracle promises

Making hair softer is realistic. Repairing it or making it grow back with kitchen ingredients is not.

All recipes

How it is done

A good recipe in four steps

01Work clean

Washed hands, bowls and tools: that is half of good storage.

02Do the patch test

A small amount on your forearm, then wait 24 hours.

03Make little

Better to make it again than to keep it for days.

04Store or discard

In the fridge and for a few days. If the smell, colour or look changes, throw it away.

An honest note

Recipes for personal use, not cosmetics for sale

In the European Union a cosmetic sold to the public must comply with Regulation (EC) 1223/2009: a safety assessment, notification to the CPNP portal and proper labelling. That is why we do not sell finished cosmetics here: we explain how to make them for yourself.

We are not hairdressers or dermatologists. With sensitive skin, dermatitis or sudden hair loss, ask a professional before trying any recipe.
